body_text:
Axiom of foundation. Every nonempty set $A$ has an element $a$
disjoint from $A$. Equivalently in the presence of the other ZF
axioms, there is no infinite descending membership chain
$x_0\ni x_1\ni x_2\ni\cdots$. Foundation supports proofs and
definitions by membership recursion and excludes self-membership
phenomena such as $x\in x$.
